column1: # Caches an app keeps using while it runs. While the app runs, scan.sh holds the folder ("app running")
# and recheck.sh refuses to delete it. One per line: the folder (a name under ~/Library/Caches, or a ~ path),
# a tab, the app bundle as it appears in the process path. A process started with --user-data-dir
# (a test or agent browser) keeps its cache in that folder and does not count.
